items.hook: The grey years were a loosely defined period in Cuban history, generally agreed to have started with the Padilla affair in 1971.
items.body: It is often associated with the tenure of Luis Pavón Tamayo as the head of Cuba's National Cultural Council from 1971 to 1976. One of those things you can't un-know.

items.hook: Astrothelium pictum is a species of corticolous (bark-dwelling), crustose lichen in the family Trypetheliaceae.
items.body: Found in Brazil, it was formally described as a new species in 2016 by Dutch lichenologist André Aptroot. The world is stranger than it lets on.
